subject: Vendor Activation - Security Checklist, Purchase Flow & Subprocessor Map
messages:
From: Samir Khan <ops@acmescale.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha@acmescale.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Getting AcmeScale set up with Redwood - DPA, SOC2 & PO questions

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to get the integration going. Procurement at AcmeScale needs three things to complete our vendor activation:

- Executed DPA (we can e-sign)
- Latest SOC 2 Type II report or a hosted link we can review
- Full subprocessor list (csv or spreadsheet) + confirmation on where logs/audit data are retained

Also: can you confirm your PO instructions (billing contact, remit-to, and expected lead time for PO processing)? Our procurement team is already prepping a purchase order and wants to avoid delays.

If you prefer, I can loop in our procurement manager — otherwise a short checklist and the right links from your side will be perfect.

Thanks,
Samir Khan
Ops Lead, AcmeScale
ops@acmescale.com


From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <ops@acmescale.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Getting AcmeScale set up with Redwood - DPA, SOC2 & PO questions

Hi Samir — thanks for the note and great meeting yesterday. Looping in Monica from Procurement and Ben from Legal so they can confirm the PO flow and DPA redline process.

Short answers up front:
- DPA: we have a standard DPA (attached) and we can sign via DocuSign. If you have required redlines, Ben will advise the review path.
- SOC 2: link to our hosted report attached (pdf).
- Subprocessors: attached csv (Subprocessors_202807.csv) with a brief description column; also confirm we persist audit logs in customer-specific retention buckets in us-west-2 by default.
- PO instructions: see attached PO_Instructions.pdf — remit-to and AP contact included. Typical PO-to-activate timeline is 2–5 business days after PO receipt + DPA signature.

Monica / Ben — can you confirm annual invoicing vs. monthly billing preference for AcmeScale and whether procurement needs any specific W-9 or vendor onboarding form? Samir — if you can share the PO number and preferred billing cadence, we’ll prioritize the activation.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v1.2.docx, SOC2_TypeII_2027-2028.pdf, Subprocessors_202807.csv, PO_Instructions.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Samir Khan <ops@acmescale.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Getting AcmeScale set up with Redwood - DPA, SOC2 & PO questions

Thanks Michael / Samir — Monica from Procurement here. Quick note on process so AcmeScale knows what to expect:

1) Send PO to procurement@redwood.ai (pdf attached) with the following fields filled: vendor name, remit-to address, tax ID, contact person, and billing cadence (monthly or annual).
2) Include vendor W-9 (US vendors) or equivalent tax form — if you’re not US-based we’ll request an IRS W-8 later.
3) Legal will route the DPA for signature once we confirm no non-standard redlines.
4) Once PO and signed DPA are received, we enable billing and mark the account for activation.

Samir — if you plan to provide an annual PO, please indicate the PO number and total contract value (it helps speed the finance entry). Also attaching a one-page PO_Instructions.pdf (same as Michael attached) for your vendor team.

Monica Patel
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Attachment: PO_Instructions.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Samir Khan <ops@acmescale.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2028 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Getting AcmeScale set up with Redwood - DPA, SOC2 & PO questions

Samir / team — quick legal aside. I reviewed the DPA v1.2 attached and logged two small confirmation items before we route for signature:

- Data retention: confirm whether AcmeScale requires logs to be retained longer than our standard 365 days (we can support extended retention but need finance sign-off for additional storage costs).
- Subprocessors: the attached csv lists our subprocessors; please flag any critical vendors you require disclosure on and we’ll provide scope notes.

If AcmeScale has any contract-standard language that must be included, please send redline markup to ben_carter@redwood.ai. Otherwise we can send the DPA to DocuSign today and Monica will process PO once DocuSign completes.

On another note: the SOC2 pdf we shared is redacted for customer-identifying material; if you require an SOC2 bridge call we can schedule that with our security team.

Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Samir Khan <ops@acmescale.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2028 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Getting AcmeScale set up with Redwood - DPA, SOC2 & PO questions

Thanks all — appreciated. Confirming:
- We will issue an annual PO (PO# AS-2028-774) and aim to send it by EOD tomorrow.
- No special retention requirements at onboarding — 365 days is fine for our initial scope.
- We reviewed the subprocessors csv and want a short note from Redwood clarifying whether backups are handled by the same subprocessor list (just to be safe).

Samir Khan
Ops Lead, AcmeScale
ops@acmescale.com
